facts.fact: 她一路跑回 Sgàthan Sìth 的 1b 号；跑到车道尽头那棵榆树下时，天色已经变得凶险可怖
facts.anchor: I ran all the way back to 1b Sgàthan Sìth. By the time I reached the elm tree at the base of the driveway, the sky had turned murderous.

facts.fact: 她脑子里反复磨着同一个问题：邻居长得和她一模一样，这怎么可能，她到底是什么东西
facts.anchor: My neighbour looked just like me. How was that even possible? What was she?

facts.fact: 雾变酸、变坏，天空凝成厚厚的云，把世界罩进一层不祥的紫光里
facts.anchor: The mist had soured and spoiled, and the sky had curdled into thick clouds, casting the world in a foreboding, violet light.

facts.fact: 卧室的窗像空洞的眼往下盯着她，两户共用的门廊遮阳篷张着口，像一具尸体的嘴
facts.anchor: The bedroom windows stared down like hollow eyes; the shared awning over the front doors gaped open like the mouth of a corpse.

facts.fact: 她把受伤的手紧抱在胸前，再也没法逼自己朝那栋房子多走一步，哪怕所有家当都还丢在里面
facts.anchor: I clutched my sore hand close to my chest. I couldn’t urge myself any further toward the house, not even for fear of all my belongings abandoned inside.

facts.fact: 她边走边可怜巴巴地抽鼻子，觉得自己又变回那个在超市里故意从父母身边走开、存心把自己弄丢的小孩
facts.anchor: I sniffled pathetically as I walked. I felt like I was a child again and walking away from my parents in the supermarket to purposefully make myself lost

facts.fact: 她过去以为所有孩子多少都想要比父母能给的多一点的爱，以为带着"有人不得不爱你"的感觉长大是正常的
facts.anchor: I used to think all children—at some level—wanted more love than their parents were able to provide.

facts.fact: 只是这一次，她心里并不偷偷盼着被找到；这次驱她出门的不是那种说不出口的钝痛，而是恐惧
facts.anchor: Only this time, I didn’t secretly want to be found.
